rights_policy.rule: PostNord search, DAGI postcode geometry, DAR addresses, BBR building records, GeoDanmark footprints and DAGI administration remain independently versioned evidence artifacts.
rights_policy.attribution: Every artifact records provider, register, product, version or retrieval time, access class, terms, required attribution, schema, CRS, digest and transformation.

sources.production_scope: Pinned individual query receipts for current validation; automated bulk extraction and redistribution require separate review.
sources.terms_note: The public finder validates Danish postcodes and addresses but does not independently publish a reusable polygon or building dataset.

sources.provider: Klimadatastyrelsen / DAGI, postcode system maintained by PostNord Danmark
sources.production_scope: Pinned current or bitemporal DAGI fildownload with entity, object version, schema, CRS, geometry status, scale, digest and terms receipt.
sources.terms_note: DAGI registers PostNord-defined postcode areas as MultiSurface with ErGadepostnummer, valid time and registration time. Administrative layers remain distinct.

sources.production_scope: Pinned API receipt or documented snapshot with query, retrieval time, upstream register versions, schema, digest and attribution.
sources.terms_note: DAWA provides a convenient public view over official address and postcode data. Preserve the originating DAGI or DAR register and do not treat the API as an independent building authority.

sources.provider: Klimadatastyrelsen and Danish municipalities / Danmarks Adresseregister (DAR)
sources.production_scope: Pinned DAR current or bitemporal fildownload with UUIDs, status, validity, registration time, source relationships, schema, CRS, digest and attribution.
sources.terms_note: Municipalities maintain the official register. The Husnummer access point determines postcode through DAGI and may explicitly reference BBR and GeoDanmark buildings; point geometry is not a footprint.

sources.production_scope: Pinned BBR fildownload or permitted distribution with building identifiers, public field allow-list, status, version, digest and distribution receipt.
sources.terms_note: BBR is the statutory building and dwelling register. Public building identity and attributes remain distinct from occupants, owners, unit data and GeoDanmark footprint geometry.

sources.production_scope: Pinned GeoDanmark Vektor fildownload with building local identifier, geometry/status, valid and registration time, schema, CRS, digest and GeoDanmark terms receipt.
sources.terms_note: GeoDanmark ground data is freely reusable with source terms and attribution. The general optional CC BY 4.0 election does not apply to GeoDanmark data; exact address linkage requires the explicit DAR/BBR relationship.

sources.production_scope: Pinned DAGI current or bitemporal fildownload with levels, identifiers, status, validity, registration time, CRS, digest and attribution.
sources.terms_note: DAGI administrative entities provide context and clipping. Their geometry never replaces the separate Postnummerinddeling entity.

artifact_partitions.contains: contracts, schemas, receipts and non-geographic synthetic fixtures only
pinned Postnummerinddeling and administrative entities with bitemporal lineage
pinned address, Husnummer, access-point and explicit building-reference fields
public building identity and approved attributes only
pinned building footprints, identifiers and required attribution
legacy-to-modern endpoint, authentication, entity and rollback mappings
Denmark proper partition and separately governed Greenland/Faroe routing exceptions
resident, owner, CPR/CVR, recipient, customer, forwarding and shipment data
